scheduled_files.link_rx.fsm:
(?fsm:link_rx

  (+types
    (type lmp_t (record (subtype (bits 4)) (payload (bits 12))))
  )

  (+system
    (clock clk)
    (areset rst_n)
  )

  (+interface
    (input start)
    (input subtype_in)
    (output done)
    (internal last_lmp)
  )

  (+size
    (start 1)
    (subtype_in 4)
    (done 1)
    (last_lmp lmp_t)
    (can_accept 1)
  )

  (receive_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<start
      (-> receive_set_1)
    )
  )

  (receive_set_1
    (<- (last_lmp.subtype subtype_in))
    (-> receive_done_2)
  )

  (receive_done_2
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (-> receive_idle_0)
  )

)
